thesis: The page is the shop's probe printout: every section touches the probe to one panel and prints a reading, so the visitor trusts a number before an adjective, and the clear coat drawn under each reading thins in the sun and builds back as we fix it.

signature.name: Probe Readout + Clear-Coat Strata
signature.summary: A mono LCD tag (value, unit, status word, Sample tag) perched on a four-film paint section drawn to thickness; the clear film shrinks, cracks or rebuilds per section. Hero answers the sun-damage sorter, hood story counts through four mil values, services and reviews print their own number, footer shows live open status.

palette.family: Caliche Chalk + Probe Ink + Clear-Coat Blue + Sun-Fail Red

layoutMoves: a mono reading column in the left 2 of 12 columns that carries each section's readout
services as a ruled test sheet with row readouts, not cards
one deep probe-night band for the pinned hood story between light runs
price list printed as a gauge tape strip

motion.intro: readout counts 0.0 to 4.6 mils while strata layers fill bottom-up, with h1 line-mask reveal, under 1.1 s
stories: count: pinned hood strata steps through four sample readings with --sw-p
draw: claim path line draws down and prints day ticks
motion.hover: probe touch: crosshair dot drops on the card corner and its readout re-counts once
